violation_type.title: Healthy Environment - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §742.801(d))
violation_type.short_title: Healthy Environment - Areas Free From Hazards
violation_type.typical_finding: The backyard where children play had an axe and a hammer where children could access it and was reported to be out at all times. The yard also had several tools and machines that pose a safety risk to children in care.

finding_variants.text: The backyard where children play had an axe and a hammer where children could access it and was reported to be out at all times. The yard also had several tools and machines that pose a safety risk to children in care.

The area was not free from hazards such as cords on the floor, cord hanging from the wall, and storage drawers with items such as diaper cream and containers stacked against the wall that could easily fall.  There are also shelves with lots of toys that don't seem secure.
Based on the DFPS investigation, the outdoor area was not free of hazards as there were ants, resulting in a child being bitten between 100-150 times.

The top of the door hinge to one of the doors opening into a room used by the children is detached from the wall. An open sack of trash was observed accessible ito children in the restroom. This was corrected at inspection as it was removed from children's access.
